title: Monitoring and logs: New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, Kibana and Sentry

videos.script: Every test in this course so far ran before the release. On your machine, at a load you chose. {{before}} Then the release goes out, and the users arrive. Thousands of them, on phones, on trains, doing things nobody modelled. {{after}} Something will go wrong there that no test caught. The only question is who notices first: you, or a customer. {{who}} This lesson gives the box office a voice. A log line for every request, each with its own id. {{log}} And a page of numbers that Prometheus collects every five seconds. How many requests, how many failed, how long they took. {{metrics}} Then you ask it questions, in its own language, while a load test runs. {{promql}} You will also meet the five products the job adverts name. New Relic, Datadog, Grafana, Kibana and Sentry. {{products}} Not their screens, which change every year. What each one is for, and which question it answers. {{signals}}
